title: Procurement Contract Specialist - US
description:
Shift Hours

Monday to Friday - 8am to 5pm.

Interview and Clearance Requirements

Interviews are required. Must be fully cleared prior to start. Do not submit candidates from previous posting WERKJP00016627. Manager will not consider them.

Top Requirements

  • 3 years of experience in purchasing/procurement and supporting a technical operations environment with lead time constraints.
  • 3 years of related experience in RFQ processes – vendor competitive bidding.
  • 3-5 years purchasing or procurement.
  • High understanding of part fabrication processes - Milling, Lathe, and Laser Sheetmetal fabrication.

Career Opportunity

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for completing required project assignments and work tasks. The focus will be on procurement processes, supporting production planning execution, and other supply chain activities. Throughout the assignment, there will be a heavy emphasis placed on safety, teamwork, and process improvements.

How You Will Impact

  • Leads by example, safety and accountability are fundamental responsibilities of each team member.
  • Helps to ensure on-time delivery of purchased parts for on-time packaging machinery build and assembly to drive on-time final packaging machine delivery to business customers.
  • Ensures safe and healthful working conditions and an organized work environment.
  • Support the Vision, Mission & Values of Safety and Operational Programs.

Responsibilities

  • Issue, update, and monitor purchase orders to ensure accurate data and reporting.
  • Communicate with vendors using email and phone to request delivery dates and current pricing.
  • Resolve supply and delivery issues with suppliers by proactively finding solutions and stressing urgency of deliveries to keep projects on schedule.
  • Monitor Purchasing group mailbox to capture data and transfer to ERP tool.
  • Interface with multiple departments (Receiving, Performance Excellence, Engineering, Production, and Accounts Payable) to complete work tasks and projects.
  • Document and update job-related work processes and procedures.
  • Send large component quote packages out for bid to multiple suppliers. Receive, manage, and organize returned information.

What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Requirements)

  • 3 years of experience in purchasing/procurement and supporting a technical operations environment with lead time constraints.
  • 3 years of related experience in RFQ processes – vendor competitive bidding.
  • 3-5 years purchasing or procurement.
  • Customer service experience in terms of both internal and external customers.
  • Teaming and collaboration skills.
  • Experience with ERP systems like JDE or SAP in material management or production planning.
  • Intermediate proficiency with MS Office suite (Microsoft 365 including Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, written and oral communication.
  • Willingness to call suppliers outside the organization with a sense of urgency and assertiveness.
  • Ability to work independently and multi-task.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to read, interpret, and understand Mechanical Technical Drawings.
  • High understanding of part fabrication processes - Milling, Lathe, and Laser Sheetmetal fabrication.

What Will Make You Stand Out for This Role (Preferred Requirements)

  • Advanced VLookup and pivot table analysis skills in Excel.
  • Demand forecasting experience.
  • Strong influential communication skills.
  • 5 years of purchasing experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • 3 years of strategic/preferred vendor management experience.
  • Some college or higher education.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

  • Work in an office/manufacturing/production environment.
  • The role is frequently sedentary, which entails sitting or being stationary.
  • Frequently stands or walks for 1-2 hours at a time.
  • Occasionally stands or walks for 3-6 hours at a time.
  • Occasionally stands or walks for over 6 hours at a time.

Performance Measurements

  • Accomplishing Packaging Machinery and Automation objectives (Ex: on-time delivery of packaging machinery to business customers).
  • Identifying cost savings opportunities through vendor selection.
  • Quality of work.
  • Working with management, colleagues, and suppliers.
  • Timeliness and accuracy of Safety goals & achievements for the facility.

Training Requirements

Safety training includes:

  • General Safety, Hazard Recognition, reporting, and resolution; personal protective equipment; Emergency Action Plan, Plant Safety Rules, Safe Lifting, other programs as required.

Job-related training includes:

  • Jobscope ERP and PTC Windchill (CAD) database operator training.
  • Standard policy training.
  • Engineering documentation orientation.
  • Process excellence training.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to:

  • Office and industrial workspaces.
  • Intermittently exposed to running production machinery.
  • The noise level in the work environment is light to moderate.

Personal Protective Equipment Used on the Job

  • Safety Glasses, hearing protection, Safety Shoes, and/or other personal protective equipment are required while performing certain tasks or visiting certain areas.
  • Observe HSE regulations, wear all required safety equipment, encourage safe working practices, correct obvious hazards immediately, or report them to the proper personnel.

description:
Schedule: 9:30am-6:30pm

Position Summary
Under moderate supervision, this role is responsible for stocking, shipping, and supporting operations by handling frames, lenses, and other product orders. Duties include pulling materials, preparing shipments, assisting with inventory, and supporting consignment and refurbishing processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Stock and ship frames, lenses, and other product orders to support operations.

  • Pull frames, parts, and related materials for daily invoice orders and new consignment sets.

  • Ship daily orders using regular mail, overnight, and ground delivery services according to department standards.

  • Support operations functions by maintaining inventory of frames, lenses, and daily shipping supplies.

  • Assist in receiving by unpacking, staging, and counting incoming orders.

  • Clean and assemble frames, lenses, and other supplies according to department guidelines.

  • Coordinate within the frame refurbishing area to improve efficiency by preparing frames and components for the refurbishing team.

  • Approximately one year of distribution or warehouse experience preferred.

  • Ability to lift up to 40 pounds.

The working environment is generally favorable, with adequate lighting and temperature. No hazardous or unpleasant conditions are typically present, such as excessive noise or dust.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python and related frameworks.
  • Build robust REST and GraphQL APIs, including designing schemas and implementing resolvers, pagination, and authorization.
  • Model, design, and optimize relational databases (PostgreSQL) queries, including indexing, migrations, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Implement and integrate ORMs (e.g., SQLAlchemy) with sound patterns for transactions and concurrency.
  • Architect and operate data pipelines and workflows using Apache Airflow (DAG design, scheduling, monitoring, retry/backfill strategies).
  • Ensure code quality through unit/integration tests and automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Apply secure development practices: authentication/authorization, secrets management, input validation, and data privacy.
  • Implement observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting to ensure reliability and performance.
  • Collaborate with product owners, data scientists, and front-end engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions aligned with business goals.
  • Document systems and APIs for maintainability and knowledge sharing.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Professional backend Python development experience (5 years) building production-grade services.
  • Strong grasp of software engineering fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency, distributed systems basics.
  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining microservices.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and related frameworks like FastAPI or Django.
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL, including schema design, normalization, indexing strategies, query planning, and performance tuning.
  • Practical experience with ORMs, transactional integrity, and managing schema evolution/migrations.
  • Experience with automated testing, linting/typing, and Git-based version control systems.
  • Experience with next-generation software methodologies such as Agile and tools such as GitLab DevOps, CI/CD, and other best practices.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate in a cross-functional, agile environment.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Skills or Experience

  • Experience with GraphQL APIs (e.g., Strawberry, Graphene) and/or RESTful services.
  • Proficiency with Apache Airflow for orchestration of ETL/ELT workflows and data pipeline reliability.
  • Experience operating services in AWS cloud environments, including containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Infrastructure-as-code familiarity (Terraform/OpenTofu, CloudFormation) and secrets/config management.
  • Performance profiling and capacity planning for high-throughput APIs.
  • Background in applied ML integrations or retrieval-augmented systems using vector stores.

What You'll Gain

  • Opportunity to build impactful systems that support Client's innovation and global operations.
  • Collaborative, inclusive culture focused on continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Exposure to a broad technology stack and complex, real-world challenges.

Travel: Less than 15%

Nesco Resource is now hiring for 3rd Shift Tool Room Tech positions at a facility in Forest City.  Training on the job! Awesome perks to include paid benefits once hired on! Apply Now!

Hours: 11:00pm-7:00am
Pay:$17.00-17.75

 

Job Summary:
The Tool Room Technician is responsible for performing a wide range of tasks related to tooling maintenance, repair, and preparation for production. Duties include cleaning die cast and trim dies, operating tool room equipment, performing machining operations, conducting tooling repairs, and supporting preventative maintenance activities. This position may range from entry-level to advanced depending on experience and skill level.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
General Tool Room Functions (All Levels):
  • Clean die cast dies, trim dies, die components, and related tool room equipment.
  • Maintain overall cleanliness and organization of the tool room.
  • Safely operate cranes, lifts, steam cleaners, and compressed air systems.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.
  • Follow company safety protocols and procedures.
Tooling and Machining Responsibilities (By Skill Level):
Trainee / Entry-Level:
  • Assist in tooling repairs and production run preparation.
  • Perform basic lathe and milling operations.
  • Use basic precision measuring instruments.
  • Learn and apply basic tooling concepts and operations.
Intermediate (Class C/B):
  • Perform most tooling repairs and maintenance.
  • Operate lathes and mills for intermediate-level machining tasks.
  • Use a variety of precision measuring instruments.
  • Read and interpret blueprints.
  • Weld and machine components to specified tolerances.
  • Machine components to close tolerances as required.
Advanced (Class A / Lead):
  • Perform all types of tooling repairs, including complex diagnostics and rebuilds.
  • Proficient in all tool room machines and equipment.
  • Use advanced machining techniques and maintain tight tolerances.
  • Fabricate tooling components from blueprints.
  • Provide on-the-job training (OJT) to Class C, B, and Trainee employees.
  • Act as Lead when required, overseeing daily workflow and prioritizing tasks.
Other Duties:
  • Maintain a safe and clean work environment.
  • Assist in training and mentoring junior tool room staff.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the supervisor or lead.
Safety Requirements:
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):
  • Safety glasses
  • Steel toe shoes
  • Ear plugs
  • Other PPE as specified by supervisor
Safety Knowledge:
  • Emergency Action Plan
  • Hazardous Communication Program
  • Accident Reporting Procedures
  • General Safety Rules and Practices
Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Experience operating tool room equipment (e.g., lathe, mill, welder).
  • Ability to read and understand blueprints and technical drawings.
  • Familiarity with tooling operations and manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and safety awareness.
  • Willingness to learn and grow within the role.

  • Wear required PPE and follow safety procedures.

  • Participate in cross training and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Maintain a clean, organized work area.

title: Network Engineer I
description:
About the Opportunity

As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure network infrastructures to protect organizations from cyber threats. This role combines networking expertise with cybersecurity measures to ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and availability.


Where you will make an impact

· Maintain network resources, including configuring network switches, server hardware, VoIP systems, operating systems, applications, and services in a wired and wireless environment.

· Maintain and improve network operations and provide support to network users.

· Configure and maintain network components (e.g., routers, switches, etc.) and services (e.g., connectivity and access).

· Perform custom configuration for complex network devices such as firewalls and VPN concentrators. Reconfiguring network equipment as necessary to handle environmental changes.

· Perform network troubleshooting to isolate and diagnose complex network problems with minor supervision, implementing solutions with limited system-wide impact.

· Escalate issues with broader implications for the entire network to higher-level network personnel, such as the Network Manager or Technical Service Director.

· Maintain the campus's wireless authentication tool(s) and serve as the primary point of contact for campus community support.

· Utilize monitoring tools to capture and analyze traffic, maintain uptime, generate usage reports, and spot trends.

· Create and maintain documentation and diagrams as needed when assets are added or removed.

· Support VOIP telecom environments, including adding/moving/changing phone equipment and ensuring that our environment stays current with product releases.

· Provide users with technical support and establish network users, user environments, and directories for networks being installed.

· Install and test necessary software and hardware in accordance with standards-based settings and client Change Management processes.

· Design and deploy security protocols, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems

· Continuously monitor network traffic for unusual activity and potential threats

· Investigate and resolve security breaches and vulnerabilities

· Conduct regular assessments to identify weaknesses and improve defenses.

· Ensure adherence to industry security standards and regulations.

What will you bring

· Higher Education background and knowledge with 2+ years of related experience and/or training.

· Experience and knowledge of configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS networking devices.

· Experience and working knowledge of Microsoft Server operating systems, Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, and Server roles such as DNS and DHCP.

· Has broad-based knowledge and hands-on experience implementing network switches.

· Practical experience with Cisco phone systems and VOIP system administration.

· Excellent time management, planning and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work effectively with end-users, understand their technical and operational needs and translate them into viable technical solutions.

· Excellent verbal and written skills, encompassing complete understanding of the English language with exceptional communication skills.

· Strong organizational and leadership skills.

· Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team, including working cross functionally

· Must participate in on-call rotation.

· Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

· Working knowledge of Linux and Windows server operating systems.

· Familiarity with network monitoring systems such as SolarWinds.

· Strong knowledge of network infrastructure and security protocols (SSL/TLS, IPSec, VPNs).

· Experience with Palo Alto firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint security.

· Certifications such as CCNA and CompTIA Security+ are highly valued.

· Analytical mindset with problem-solving skills to address security challenges.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
As an Electrical Engineer at Hayden Industrial, you will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and improving electrical systems and equipment within the manufacturing facility. This role ensures electrical reliability, safety, and efficiency to support production operations, while also driving process improvements and supporting capital projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain electrical systems, control circuits, and power distribution for plant operations.
  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve electrical issues with manufacturing equipment and facility systems.
  • Develop and maintain preventive and predictive maintenance programs for electrical systems.
  • Collaborate with production, maintenance, and engineering teams to identify process improvements and implement automation solutions.
  • Support installation, testing, and commissioning of new equipment and electrical systems.
  • Ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal electrical codes, safety standards, and company policies.
  • Prepare and maintain electrical drawings, schematics, and documentation.
  • Work with outside contractors, vendors, and utility companies as needed.
  • Provide technical training and support to maintenance staff and operators.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, reduce downtime, and optimize energy usage.

Hayden Industrial has determined this position involves safety-sensitive job duties and will be considered a safety-sensitive position for purpose of the Oklahoma Medical Marijuana and Patient Protection Act ("The Unity Bill.”) effective August 29th, 2019.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in electrical engineering within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical distribution systems, PLCs, VFDs, HMIs, and automation controls.
  • Proficiency with electrical design software (AutoCAD Electrical or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with NFPA 70E, NEC, OSHA, and other safety regulations.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Supervisor Responsibility: This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment: This job is based in a manufacturing environment with a combination of office and plant floor responsibilities. This role uses standard office equipment. When in the manufacturing facility, all employees are required to wear personal protective equipment to include/hearing protection, and safety glasses with side shields, and OSHA compliant safety boots/shoes.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing duties of this job, the employee in this position is regularly required to stand for long periods of time. This position requires walking, the ability to reach, ascend/descend ladders, bend, kneel, and stoop. The employee occasionally will lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work: This is an exempt position. This is a full-time position with travel between the Tulsa and Claremore locations. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required.

Travel: Travel is required for this position.

title: Process Engineer
description:
Position Summary:
As a Process Engineer I, you will be responsible for developing, improving, and supporting manufacturing processes that produce advanced technology products. Working under the direction of a Senior Engineer or Manager, you will contribute to new product introductions, process development, cost reduction initiatives, equipment validation, and capital justifications. This role requires strong analytical skills and close collaboration with Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to ensure processes are efficient, cost-effective, and aligned with quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and implement manufacturing processes for new and existing products.
• Collaborate with Production, Tool Design, Tool & Die, and Maintenance regarding manufacturing methods, tooling, and equipment.
• Establish routings for new products and determine associated manufacturing costs.
• Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis of process-related production issues.
• Partner with Quality Control to identify inspection methods, gauges, and critical features for new products.
• Conduct and document equipment validation activities including IQ, OQ, PQ, and re-validation as required.
• Monitor and follow up on part, tooling, and routing changes during initial production runs until processes are stabilized and products are accepted.
• Collect and analyze process data to monitor performance, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
• Evaluate machinery, tooling, and process technologies, making recommendations for upgrades or replacement.
• Lead or support cost reduction projects by implementing efficient and innovative manufacturing methods.
• Assist or lead in the development and implementation of lean processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Prepare and maintain process documentation including work instructions, routings, validation protocols/reports, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret process data and develop solutions.
• Effective communication and teamwork skills to collaborate across functions.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Preferred Qualifications:
• Internship, co-op, or industry experience in manufacturing or process engineering.
• Training or certification in Lean Manufacturing and/or Six Sigma.
• Familiarity with CAD tools, data analysis software, and process/equipment validation methods (IQ, OQ, PQ).

Job title: Sr Maintenance Tech

JOB DUTIES:

  • Perform routine, preventative maintenance and unscheduled repairs on induction furnaces and other equipment within the plant which may include mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic troubleshooting as necessary. Identify and recommend improvement opportunities in the preventative maintenance system.
  • Work closely with production teams to schedule maintenance during planned downtimes.
  • Work from engineering drawings, schematics, work orders, and manuals.

  • Document maintenance activities, repairs, and inspections in maintenance logs or CMMS.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations, including lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures and PPE requirements.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and repair work on facility mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other installed systems.
  • Operate equipment pertaining to maintenance including fork trucks, scissor lifts, and aerial lifts.
  • Housekeeping and organization as required, as well as other duties as requested by manager, ensuring that all safety requirements are practiced.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
  • 7+ years of Maintenance Technician experience required. Journeyman card a plus
  • Electrical experience required
  • PLC troubleshooting required, programming a plus
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, and electrical/mechanical prints.
  • Experience with power distribution, instrumentation, and PLC controls.

description:

We are seeking a skilled and reliable Maintenance Technician to join our team at a fast-paced vitamin and dietary supplement manufacturing facility.   • Strong mechanical aptitude and experience with tools and diagnostic equipment.
  • Knowledge of GMP, FDA regulations, and safety standards.
  • Ability to read blueprints, schematics, and equipment manuals.
  • Basic computer skills and familiarity with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs and work in standing, climbing, or crouching positions for extended periods.

title: Server Vulnerability & Patch Management Engineer
description:
We're seeking a Server Vulnerability & Patch Management Engineer to drive system hardening, patch automation, and remediation initiatives across enterprise infrastructure. The role focuses on maintaining secure and compliant server environments through proactive vulnerability monitoring, patch lifecycle management, and collaboration with global infrastructure and security teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and optimize automated patching workflows for Windows and Linux servers, ensuring timely deployment of critical updates.

  • Coordinate with packaging and engineering teams to test and validate software packages before deployment in production.

  • Perform on-demand patching and vulnerability remediation, including software removal or configuration adjustments.

  • Develop and implement Group Policies and configuration baselines to strengthen operating system and application security.

  • Track, analyze, and report vulnerabilities across physical, virtual, and cloud-based server environments, ensuring accurate risk visibility.

  • Partner with infrastructure, operations, and cybersecurity teams to plan and execute remediation campaigns and compliance initiatives.

  • Evaluate legacy systems or end-of-life software components, documenting remediation strategies and upgrade paths.

  • Leverage vulnerability management and log analysis tools (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Splunk) to proactively identify risks and verify remediation.

  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, dashboards, and audit evidence supporting patch and vulnerability management processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with endpoint configuration and patch management platforms (e.g., Microsoft MECM/SCCM, Ansible, or equivalent).

  • Solid knowledge of Windows Server and Linux/Unix operating systems and administration best practices.

  • Proficiency with Active Directory management, Group Policy creation, and security hardening techniques.

  • Working familiarity with vulnerability assessment and SIEM tools such as Qualys, Nessus, or Splunk.

  • Understanding of virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V) and lifecycle maintenance for on-prem and virtual infrastructure.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into actionable remediation plans.

PAY Rate: $65 - $75 / hour

description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Signage Installer to join our dynamic team. The Signage Installer will be responsible for the professional installation of various types of signage, including exterior and interior signs, illuminated displays, vinyl graphics, and vehicle wraps. This role requires technical expertise, physical stamina, and a commitment to delivering high-quality installations while adhering to safety standards and project timelines.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Sign Installation:
  • Install a variety of signage, including channel letters, monument signs, wall graphics, vehicle wraps, and illuminated signs, at client locations.
  • Safely operate equipment such as ladders, scissor lifts, boom lifts, and cranes to install signs at various heights and locations.
  • Secure signs using appropriate mounting techniques, ensuring compliance with local building codes and regulations.
  • Perform electrical connections for illuminated signs, including wiring and LED installations, following safety protocols.
  • Site Preparation and Assessment:
  • Conduct site surveys to assess installation requirements, including measurements, structural considerations, and permitting needs.
  • Coordinate with clients and project managers to ensure proper placement and alignment of signage.
  • Prepare installation sites by clearing obstacles, setting up equipment, and ensuring a safe work environment.
  • Maintenance and Repairs:
  • Perform maintenance on existing signage, including replacing bulbs, LEDs, or damaged components.
  • Troubleshoot and repair issues with sign functionality, such as electrical or structural problems.
  • Safety and Compliance:
  • Adhere to OSHA standards, local regulations, and company safety policies during all installations.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area at job sites to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Use personal protective equipment (PPE) and follow proper safety procedures when working at heights or with electrical systems.
  • Collaboration and Communication:
  • Work closely with project managers, designers, and clients to ensure installations meet design specifications and client expectations.
  • Provide updates on project progress and report any issues or delays to supervisors.

title: Shipping Inventory Clerk
description:
Responsibilities
The primary goal is to satisfying customer requirements of quality, quantity, and delivery, in a safe manner, while maximizing productivity. Specifically, the Shipping and Inventory Clerk is responsible for all job activities required to support production processes. These activities include but are not limited to: assisting in a variety of warehouse duties, including shipping and receiving, building pallets/crates and packaging materials for shipping, monitoring and maintaining inventory; preparing work to be accomplished by studying assembly instructions, blueprint specifications, and parts lists; gathering parts, subassemblies, tools, and materials (kitting).

Other responsibilities:

  • Maintains supplies inventory by checking stock to determine inventory level; anticipating needed supplies; placing and expediting orders for supplies; verifying receipt of supplies
  • Package, secure and load product
  • Track and prepare documents for product while monitoring database activity for inventory
  • Communicate effectively with vendors when necessary, both verbally and in writing.
  • Maintains dock and storage facilities in an organized manner; receives, unpacks, and delivers goods; restocks items as necessary; labels shelves
  • Maintains all necessary associated documentation to support shipping and inventory activity
  • Follows all plant safety guidelines; practices and procedures. Must be aware of activity in the work surroundings and maintain a clean and safe work area
  • Properly use personal protective equipment when required
  • Positions parts and subassemblies by using templates or reading measurements
  • Supports all departments with inventory needs
  • Perform other tasks as assigned

Qualifications
Prior manufacturing experience is highly preferred. Any technical or vocational education/training in relation to skills listed below is also desirable.
  • Blueprint reading knowledge preferred
  • Must have basic computer skills (primarily Microsoft Excel)
  • Must have basic measurement and math skills; must have knowledge of basic hand tools and measuring instruments
  • Forklifts and Overhead crane experience preferred (in-house training available)
  • SAP experience desirable
  • Must be able to pass a background check and pre employment drug test
  • Team player - must be able to work with others and/or alone
  • Must have and maintain a high sense of urgency to meet and exceed all production goals
  • Attentive to detail watching for material defects, quality issues, inventory levels
  • Physically capable of standing, walking, bending, pushing, pulling, reaching and twisting throughout shift
  • Capable of repetitively lifting 25-50 lbs.
  • Must maintain regular attendance – have reliable transportation
  • Candidates must be flexible to work overtime as needed, which may include weekends and/or holidays

Work Environment
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee works in typical manufacturing environment with overhead cranes and forklifts.
  • Overhead LED lights throughout the workspace create a bright workspace for employees to safely perform their work.
  • Normally clean work environment where the process creates some grinding dust, heat/cold, fumes/odors, and vibration. Housekeeping is performed as needed throughout the day and at the end of each shift.
  • The noise level in the work environment is normal to manufacturing processes with air tools, grinders, and other tools. Yearly audiometric testing is provided by the company to monitor areas for improvement.
  • Non-climate-controlled facility in the summer, each work area is provided with fans to help keep cool. In the winter it is heated.

High School Diploma or equivalent
Entry level experience (training may be provided)

Steel Toe Shoes/Boots

description:

Shift: First Shift

Job Summary
The Assembly Technician is responsible for completing bonded sub-assemblies using honeycomb, composite, or fiberglass materials. This role involves drilling, reaming, riveting, and installing fasteners to precise specifications, as well as assembling structural components using specialized tools, jigs, and fixtures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform all operations necessary for the installation, assembly, and mating of structural sub-assemblies.

  • Build and assemble components using tooling to establish primary locations; lay out and locate holes, trim lines, and parts using direct measurements.

  • Load and unload jigs, and perform required work or rework in or outside of tooling fixtures.

  • Carry out other duties as required by the position.

  • Loud work environment; hearing protection is required.

  • Safety glasses and fully enclosed, ANSI-compliant steel/composite-toe shoes must be worn in all manufacturing areas.

  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings and mylars.

  • Understanding of adhesive and pre-preg material handling.

  • Familiarity with precision measurement tools and dimensional tolerances.

Implement a structured approach to managing requirement changes throughout the product lifecycle.

Specifications (HRS), Printed Board Assembly (PBA) Design Specifications, Software Test Plans and Procedures compliant with DO-178 for Software/System Requirement Verification, and Hardware Verification Test Plans and Procedures adhering to DO-254 for Airborne Complex Electronic Hardware Requirement Verification, along with essential certification documents.
• Design System Verification Test Cases and procedures to meet compliance with DO-178 and DO-254 standards. Establish metrics and validation criteria to ensure rigorous system testing and evaluation.
• Develop and maintain advanced GPS/INS Navigation simulation tools and covariance analysis tests for Performance Verification Testing. Utilize Kalman Filter measurement error state-based design and selection methods to support software development goals and optimize navigation solutions.
• Oversee the complete integration of M-Code, P(Y)-Code and SPS GPS receivers within the Embedded GPS/INS product line, providing technical support for a wide range of system integration, verification, and validation efforts throughout the development lifecycle.

frameworks, computer-based modeling and simulation test environment, and Monte Carlo test frameworks, enhancing the efficiency of testing processes and ensuring high fidelity in simulation outputs.

strategic initiatives to mitigate them proactively, ensuring the sustained delivery of project objectives.

• Provide leadership and mentorship to engineering team members throughout all phases of product development. Support their growth and development in requirements definition, system architecture, software architecture, hardware architecture, documentation, integration, and verification/validation processes.
• Provide on-request technical support for fielded systems, ensuring operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

title: Hose Former
description:
GENERAL SUMMARY
 
Responsible for the efficient manufacture and quality forming of production parts (Hoses) within the assigned department. 
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Duties required for successful job performance):
 
  1. Check specifications as to job and perform numbers.
  2. Retrieve proper pre-form and guide onto mandrel using lubricant as necessary.
  3. Position loaded mandrels in curing rack for curing. Move curing rack into autoclave when full.
  4. Remove curing rack from autoclave to proper work area.
  5. Position mandrel bars for unloading. Remove formed hose from mandrel, place into proper container.
  6. Position full baskets with proper job and employee clock numbers.
  7. Identify parts baskets with proper job and employee clock numbers.
  8. Set up curing racks per production and supervisor guidance.
  9. Replenish lubricant in trough as needed.
  10. Perform all operations according to standard practice or as directed by supervisor to produce quality parts.
  11. Fill out required paperwork as necessary.
  12. Record cure charts as required.
  13. Perform other miscellaneous duties required but not listed above.
 
REQUIRED EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE (These are the traditional minimum, or required, bona-fide occupational qualifications and other requirements of most people in this job).
 
  1. High School Diploma or GED required. Previous manufacturing experience preferred (particularly in a team environment).
  2. NCRC certified preferred.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those needed to perform the essential functions of the job).
 
  1. Interpersonal Skills Must be able to read and write at a medium level for the purpose of understanding and applying quality documentation and standard operating procedures, along with completion of job / time reporting.
  2. Problem-solving May be asked to participate in continuous improvement activities and perform basic mathematics.
  3. Physical / Mental / Visual abilities Duties of job require periods of standing, use of hands (pushing and pulling >50 lbs.) and fingers, bending and reaching, lifting (>50lbs.) and movement of materials frequently. Must be able to visually interpret work instructions.
 
REQUIRED DECISION-MAKING AND ORGANIZATION IMPACT (Describe the typical types of decisions made by employees in this job and the likely impact of those decisions on the Company).
 
  1. The position will decide on a daily basis the acceptable level of quality for finished product to be shipped to the customer.
  2. This determination will be based upon interpretation of the customer specifications and past experience.
  3. Customer rejections of finished product could incur additional costs and may jeopardize the sourcing of business to the company.
 
REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS (Indicate job titles for this job's supervisor and direct reports).
 
  1. Directly Reports To: Group Leader / Shift Supervisor
  2. Indirectly Reports To: Business Unit Manager- II
 
WORKING CONDITIONS (Describe the environment within which the work is performed).
 
  1. Work time will be spent in general factory floor environments.
  2. Temperature and noise may vary depending on external environmental conditions.
  3. Lack of attention and carelessness may result in personal injury to self or others.

description:
SERVICE TECHNICIAN
**MUST HAVE A RESUME THAT DISPLAYS MINIMUM 2 YEARS OF MACHINERY BUILDING AND/OR SERVICE EXPERIENCE **
Pay: $20-26/hr based on experience
Shift: Mon-Friday 7am to 330pm
Flexibility is necessary due to varying Customer requirements. Occasional evening, 3rd shift, and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
The position is responsible for the installation, startup assistance, and servicing machinery of various types. These may be glass processing machines, food processing machines, or packaging machines, depending on the Division that requires the work. Installation may involve marking centerlines, manipulating machines into position, leveling, anchoring, reassembly, re-wiring, re-plumbing, etc. to bring the machine to operational readiness. After installation, the technician may be involved in troubleshooting any problems found after installation. Besides installation, existing machines may need to be serviced. This may include visits to the customer's site for preventative maintenance, troubleshooting problems, making recommendations for parts that are required, and generally helping the customer with any problems that they may have with the machine, within the power and knowledge of the technician. When not in the field, the technician may be required to help assemble machinery, startup machinery on the factory floor, and training of other individuals.
Essential Functions
  • Travel to customer plant site/s to assist customer with install, and starting up machine. Test machine to customer satisfaction. Report issues to staff for corrective action and/or future improvements.
  • Travel to customer site for machinery service, maintenance, training, etc.

  • Wire machinery to control panels according to schematics
  • Assist Engineering/programmer with startup of machines
  • Train customer or other team members
  • Make recommendations to customers for parts that they will need and relay that information to Sales for quoting.
  • Ensure customers are completely satisfied with the machines.
  • Report working and traveling hours via a Service Report to HR, and obtain customer feedback via form.
Competencies
  • Ability to read mechanical blueprints, as well as pneumatic and electrical blueprints
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose mechanical and electrical issues with equipment
  • Precision alignment, including use of indicators and other types of instruments needed for installation, alignment and calibration of machines.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally without issue

title: Scientist - I
description:
Job Description
Vaccine Drug Product Development, a part of ***'s Research Laboratories in West Point, PA, is seeking a Contract Scientist or Engineer to join our department for one year. The selected candidate will work as part of a team responsible for the design and development of vaccine drug products from preclinical through Phase III with a line of sight to commercialization. The successful candidate will work hands-on in a fast-paced laboratory and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to develop the next generation of vaccine drug products.

Primary responsibilities include the design, execution, and documentation of laboratory activities supporting formulation of Client vaccine antigens (e.g., RNA, live virus vaccines, subunit, conjugate etc.), adjuvants, and delivery systems.

Responsibilities:
• Design and perform hypothesis-driven formulation and process development experiments for sterile vaccine drug products (buffers, stabilizers, antigen/adjuvant, vials, syringes) across multiple vaccine modalities (subunit, conjugate, live-attenuated, etc.).
• Prepare formulations and fill vials/syringes for characterization & animal studies using aseptic technique and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP); support transfer to GMP manufacturing.
• Conduct stability and forced-degradation studies; analyze data, summarize findings, and author technical reports and electronic notebook entries.
• Operate and troubleshoot benchtop unit operations (mixing, filtration, pumping, lyophilization), common lab instruments (pH, scales, pipettes), and analytical tools (DLS, SLS, KF, DSC, DSF)
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (discovery, analytical, manufacturing, regulatory) to meet project timelines and deliverables.
• Continuously learn and apply current literature, methods, and technologies to improve formulations and processes.
• Support selected analytical studies on formulated products such as osmolality, viscosity, pH, and dynamic light scattering.
• Follow safe laboratory practices and maintain the work area in a clean orderly and safe manner.
• Draft, review and execute protocols for batch manufacture.

Quals--
Minimum Education Requirements:
B.S. in Chemical/Biochemical/Biomedical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Immunology, Materials Science, or related field with 1-2 years of relevant experience.

Required Skills and Experience:
• Hands-on laboratory experience (academic or industry) with basic sterile technique, buffer preparation, and sample handling.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience documenting experiments in electronic or paper lab notebooks.
• Basic data analysis skills and ability to summarize and visualize experimental results
• Scientific and mechanical aptitude and experience maintaining, designing, and/or operating scientific equipment and machinery.
• Ability to follow safe laboratory practices and maintain work area in a clean orderly and safe manner.
• Team-oriented, motivated to learn, and able to manage multiple priorities under technical supervision.
• Comfortable working in a face-paced environment and adapting to change

Desired Skills and Experience:
• Familiarity with biophysical/biochemical analytical methods (e.g., DLS, HPLC, SDS-PAGE, UV/Vis).
• Understanding of aseptic/formulation processes in a non-GMP or GMP environment.
• Familiarity with statistical/design-of-experiments tools (JMP, Minitab) or numerical software (Matlab).
• A desire to develop complex pharmaceutical products and continuously learn.
• A passion to contribute to the development of pharmaceutical products with a significant potential to impact global human health.


Preferred candidates will have experience in drug product development techniques (e.g. formulation, filtration, analytical/biochemical/biophysical characterization, and process development).

Note:
• Positions available: 2
• 100% lab based onsite role.

title: Redaction Coordinator
description:
As a Case Reviewer, you will play a critical role in processing case files by reviewing content, redacting confidential information, and preparing documents for release. The work is consistent, standardized, and repetitious, focusing on maintaining high levels of productivity and precision in a fast-paced environment. This position supports child protective services by ensuring that redacted copies are accurately prepared and distributed to authorized requestors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review cases involving child abuse and neglect to identify sensitive information requiring redaction.
  • Meet production requirements by researching and processing cases to release redacted copies to requestors in a timely manner.
  • Achieve and maintain accuracy requirements, including a current 98% accuracy rate in all redaction tasks.
  • Comprehend and redact five primary pieces of information:
    1. Source details
    2. Attorney-client privilege communications
    3. Department of Public Safety (DPS) results
    4. Social Security Numbers
    5. Child placement information
  • Perform consistent, standardized, and repetitious tasks while adhering to all relevant policies, procedures, and legal guidelines.
  • Collaborate with team members and supervisors to ensure efficient workflow and compliance with confidentiality protocols.

  • At least 1-2 years of experience in administrative, investigative, or case management roles, preferably in child welfare, social services, or a similar field.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel) and basic database systems.
  • Excellent reading comprehension, analytical skills, and ability to work independently in a repetitious environment.
  • Must pass a background check, including clearance for working with sensitive child-related data; candidates with any indicated child abuse or maltreatment reports may be disqualified.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of child protective services protocols, legal redaction standards, or privacy laws (e.g., HIPAA, FERPA).

What We Offer
